reference.source: User-supplied photo of faucet with blue soap net
reference.usedFor: short blue open-mesh bag, ivory soap and thin wire hanger around faucet neck
reference.assumptions: Exact fibre, hanger alloy, knot pattern, age and dimensions are not recoverable from the photo. Nylon/stainless and dimensions are explicit modeling assumptions, not a historical SKU claim.

manufactureInstallation.loadPath: Existing inlet neck -> closed wire loop -> curved drop -> split wire mouth handle -> bound net -> gathered heel -> soap. Static authored pose, not a cloth/contact solve.
manufactureInstallation.interfaces: Yarn path envelope is expanded around the modeled soap. Vertices and triangle centres remain outside the analytic soap volume at all LODs; this is not exhaustive triangle-triangle contact proof. Wire/cord joint overlaps are intentional assembly contacts.
manufactureInstallation.orientationExposure: Gravity-down hanging pose, mouth upward, soap at lower bag. Dry maintained reference; final wetness/residue depends on scene state.
manufactureInstallation.agingCausality: Used soap rounding is geometry. No arbitrary grime/rust or painted wet glints. Net fade and soap residue are not baked because exposure history is unknown.
manufactureInstallation.geometryVsMaterial: All holes are true open spaces between 3D yarns. Hanger wire, mouth binding and soap are geometry. Fine fibre/soap signal is material-only.
